applies_to: AP_INVOICES_ALL, AP_CHECKS_ALL, AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, AP_EXPENSE_REPORT_HEADERS_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL
description: All _ALL tables must include AND org_id filter to prevent cross-org data leakage
Must filter BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date using TRUNC(SYSDATE)
Must filter BETWEEN dates AND primary_flag = 'Y' to get single active assignment
Add AND cancelled_date IS NULL to exclude voided invoices from AP reports
Add AND void_date IS NULL to exclude void payment instruments
Add AND summary_flag = 'N' to prevent double-counting summary accounts
Must include AND source = 'NonValidatedWebExpense' to isolate iExpense rows from AP
SELECT * is prohibited in EBS — always name columns explicitly
Correlated scalar subqueries execute per row — use JOINs or WITH clause instead
Dynamic SQL with EXECUTE IMMEDIATE must use bind variables — never concatenate user input
LIKE '%value' forces full table scan — use LIKE 'value%' or function-based index
NOT IN with a subquery that returns NULLs always returns empty set — use NOT EXISTS
ROWNUM applied before ORDER BY gives random rows — wrap in subquery or use FETCH FIRST
Always use the _VL (view) or filter language = USERENV('LANG') on base table
Never hardcode numeric org_id values — use mo_global.get_current_org_id() function
Inventory tables require organization_id filter to avoid cross-warehouse aggregation
Must filter by currency_code to avoid summing across currencies in GL balance queries
Filter authorization_status = 'APPROVED' unless reporting all POs including drafts
Use payment_status_flag = 'Y' for fully paid or 'N' for outstanding invoices
Filter status != 'CL' for open items; use gl_date for posted-only AR transactions
Filter period_type and closing_status = 'O' for open periods only
Date comparisons without TRUNC may miss time-component rows — use TRUNC(date_col)
Applying functions to indexed columns (e.g. TO_CHAR(date)) suppresses index use
Tables listed in FROM without JOIN condition produce cartesian product — always check join predicates
Literal values in WHERE clauses prevent cursor sharing — use bind variables :param
EBS FK constraints use RELY DISABLE NOVALIDATE — never add enforced FKs on EBS tables
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE is for debugging only — remove from production PL/SQL packages
